summary: AC Immune SA filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 11, 2026. The filing details shareholder votes on routine matters including approval of financial statements, compensation reports, discharge of directors and executives, re-election of board members and auditors, and amendments to the articles of association regarding a capital band and increased conditional share capital for employee benefit plans. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is present. This is a standard periodic report of a foreign private issuer's annual meeting outcomes, not a special-situation event.
